reason: A self-contained DeepSeek Harness web UI theme that changes visual styling, layout, and bundled artwork, with local installation and profile configuration steps documented in the README.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供包含布局、视觉样式和本地插画资源的 Gouden Leeuw 主题。
summaries.en: A Gouden Leeuw theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI that provides custom layout, visual styling, and bundled local artwork.

capabilities: Applies a custom visual theme and layout to the DeepSeek Harness web UI
Bundles and serves local image assets through same-origin routes
Installs or removes the plugin and updates the local web profile configuration
